review.material: The proceedings DOI record was inspected, and ACADIA’s official award-recipient list independently confirms Knight’s 2023 Teaching Award of Excellence. The four-page proceedings contribution was not accessible.
review.limitations: The award record verifies recognition, not the full content or authorship role of every passage in the proceedings contribution. No learning-effectiveness experiment is inferred.

evidence.locator: Past Recipients: Terry Knight, Teaching Award of Excellence, 2023
evidence.description: Primary organizational confirmation of the award.

sections.title: What this source is
sections.text: An award-related contribution in ACADIA’s 2023 proceedings, associated with Knight’s Teaching Award of Excellence. ACADIA’s own recipient list confirms the award and year.

sections.title: What the evidence establishes
sections.text: The organizational list establishes professional recognition. It does not establish which pedagogical techniques the proceedings text explains, nor supply a controlled assessment of student learning.

sections.title: What remains unread
sections.text: The four-page proceedings text was unavailable for this review. Its specific narrative, quotations and conclusions are therefore not summarized.

sections.title: How to read it
sections.text: Use it for historical and biographical context, then follow any cited teaching materials or research papers for methods and evidence. An award citation and an educational effectiveness study answer different questions.
